messages:
Jordan Patel: Quick sync — we need a concrete operator-shim + upgrade contract for private deploys so customers can upgrade across minor/major runtime and network changes without manual netops work. Top concerns: rollback safety, DNS/KMS handoff, and incremental canaries.
Priya Singh: Can you clarify scope? is this only for VPC-connected installs or also fully air-gapped on-prem? :eyes:
Jordan Patel: Both. Air-gapped needs an offline bundle + operator that can reconcile with no outbound calls. VPC installs should support delegated DNS and optional controller-to-controlplane callbacks.
Luca Marino: Proposed primitive: a TenantOperator CRD that encodes the upgrade contract. It exposes safeTransitionMode, preserveIP, dnsMode, kmsRef, and snapshotPolicy. Example:```apiVersion: infra.redwood.com/v1
kind: TenantOperator
spec:
  safeTransitionMode: snapshot|stream
  preserveIP: true
  dnsMode: delegated|managed|none
  kmsRef: customer-kms://alias/ri-keys
  snapshotPolicy: daily
```
Priya Singh: Nice. We should require a preflight check command that customers run pre-upgrade: `rictl operator preflight --target-version X.Y` which outputs a compact JSON report and an autogenerated remediation script.
Samantha Lee: From product/field POV gating checklist idea: 1) operator compatibility matrix, 2) snapshot + rollback verified, 3) DNS delegation validated (or migration plan if not delegated), 4) customer acceptance signoff for IP changes, 5) KMS access test.
Luca Marino: For rollback safety the operator must create immutable state snapshots and a reversible db migration path. Also prefer declarative overlay patches rather than destructive transforms. Implementation detail: store snapshots in customer-managed S3 (or provided artifact path) for airgap.
Priya Singh: Edge case: customers that rely on static external load balancer IPs. We need `preserveIP:true` semantics + a documented cutoff window where we can reassign. If not possible, operator must fail upgrade and surface a remediation message.
Jordan Patel: Agree. Also add metrics that must be reported during canary: reconcilation time, API error rate, tokenization latency (where relevant), and operator resource usage. We need to define SLOs and an error budget that triggers automatic halt.
Samantha Lee: Launch phasing proposal: Phase A (dry-run customers, opt-in), Phase B (1% of fleet canary, automated rollback), Phase C (customer opt-in batch), Phase D (general availability). Each phase has gating criteria.
Luca Marino: How about kustomize overlays + a single patch CLI for customers to opt-in to `preserveIP` and `dnsMode=delegated`? Example: `kubectl patch tenantoperator ri --type merge -p '{"spec":{"preserveIP":true}}'`
Priya Singh: For airgap we need an offline operator bundle generator: `rictl bundle create-operator --version X.Y --include-crds` that spits out tarball with install.sh and checksums. Add a signing step for integrity.
ops-bot: Auto-note: created tracking ticket INF-1423 "operator-shim upgrade contract" and added owners: @Jordan Patel, @Luca Marino, @Priya Singh
Samantha Lee: QA asks: we need a small e2e harness that runs in a sandbox to validate the upgrade path and emit a pass/fail artifact customers can attach to support tickets. This should run as part of the canary pipeline.
Jordan Patel: Ownership & next steps: Luca to draft CRD + preflight spec by EOW, Priya to draft bundle CLI UX and airgap checklist, Samantha to define gating metrics and QA harness. Can we meet Thurs 11am PT to review? :calendar:
deploy-bot: Release note draft for operator-shim v0.1 has been created on the docs repo (PR #2314). :shipit:
